scope: Offline saved stock HJL ELF and Tcl inspection. No target execution, hardware measurement, router or packet contact.

wca_nat_entry_get.source:
proc ::gw::wca_nat_entry_get {args} {
  set ifnm wca_nat_entry_get
  set res 0
  log -tag itfbgn -msg $args
  helper_output_declare aIn
  helper_output_init aOut
  set res [eval wca_nat_entry_cmd "-operation get -out aOut $args"]
  helper_parray aOut
  log -tag itfend
  return $res
}

findings.queue: Queue index limited to 0..7. Caller read_clear is passed into L2/L3 AAL setters and replaces bit 5 before the egress VOQ read. Output has eight 32-bit fields. Some port branches combine L2/L3 contributions.
findings.nat_lookup: The SDK get and iterator consult hash age and can unlink/free stale software records. A single getter response is neither a wire hit counter nor an independent untouched expiration observation.
findings.nat_dump: nat_table_dump reads under a read lock and prints multiple entries, calls the age getter, and has no explicit free call in the traced function. Lower-layer effects and IROS initialization are not established.
findings.session_delete: Driver hook ca_kh_nat_entry_session_delete calls ca_nat_entry_get then ca_nat_entry_delete, which can call aal_hash_delete. This does not establish the trigger or elapsed time for any live conntrack or policy event.
